title: Clinical significance of plasma pTau217 in the care of patients in German outpatient memory clinics
summary: The aim of this project is to examine the extent to which pTau217 in plasma can predict Alzheimer's pathology in memory outpatients in Germany. The aim is to examine samples from 20 subjects with AD pathology, 20 subjects with amyloid pathology and 20 subjects without pathology from 10-15 centers of the German Network of Memory Outpatient Clinics (DNG). The samples were taken from the respective biobanks.
conditions: Dementia in Alzheimer disease with late onset
Dementia in Alzheimer disease with early onset
